articles.title: Microsoft 365 outage: how to avoid the single point of failure that paralyzes a business
articles.excerpt: Originally published in French on surmon.cloud. In short: To avoid a single point of failure, a business starts by mapping its dependencies, then diversifies its providers. France Num recommends favor…
articles.body: Originally published in French on surmon.cloud . In short: To avoid a single point of failure, a business starts by mapping its dependencies, then diversifies its providers. France Num recommends favoring European solutions to keep better control over data and costs. A fallback plan with another provider protects the most critical tools. > "Today, we must avoid as much as possible having a single point of failure that paralyzes the whole company because one server is down at a provider, however big it is." The global Microsoft 365 outage of November 12, 2026 shows what a single point of failure costs: email, calendar and the tools that depend on them all stop at the same time. It is the right moment to move to a more resilient and more sovereign model.

articles.title: Building PolicyLens with Claude: Can We Make Government Policies Easier to Understand?
articles.excerpt: I've been exploring ideas for a small project where I could use Anthropic's Claude API to solve a practical problem rather than build another generic AI chatbot for a client. One idea that caught my a…
articles.body: I've been exploring ideas for a small project where I could use Anthropic's Claude API to solve a practical problem rather than build another generic AI chatbot for a client. One idea that caught my attention is something I'm calling PolicyLens. The problem I'm trying to solve Government policies, public schemes, regulatory notifications and official circulars often contain information that people genuinely need. But finding that information and understanding what it actually means are two different things. A document might be 30–50 pages long, filled with formal language, eligibility conditions, exceptions, application procedures and deadlines. Someone might only want to know: Am I eligible? What documents do I need? What benefits are available? Is there a deadline? How do I apply?
articles.author: Surya S S

articles.title: Guardrail no input e no output
articles.excerpt: Resposta curta Guardrails de no input e no output são mecanismos técnicos que bloqueiam intencionalmente a ingestão ou emissão de dados em etapas críticas do fluxo de processamento de IA — sem depende…
articles.body: Resposta curta Guardrails de no input e no output são mecanismos técnicos que bloqueiam intencionalmente a ingestão ou emissão de dados em etapas críticas do fluxo de processamento de IA — sem depender de análise semântica, mas sim de regras estritas de presença/ausência. Eles atuam como barreiras de controle de acesso e vazamento, fundamentais para conformidade com políticas internas de governança de IA. TL;DR Guardrails no input impedem a entrada de dados não autorizados no sistema — por exemplo, textos contendo padrões de CPF, CNPJ ou e-mails em campos não validados. Guardrails no output suprimem ou redirecionam respostas que contenham informações sensíveis, mesmo que geradas corretamente pelo modelo.
articles.author: Matheus Feijão

articles.title: Guardrail no tribunal
articles.excerpt: Resposta curta Guardrail no tribunal refere-se à aplicação de mecanismos técnicos e éticos de governança de IA para assegurar que sistemas de inteligência artificial usados em órgãos do Poder Judiciár…
articles.body: Resposta curta Guardrail no tribunal refere-se à aplicação de mecanismos técnicos e éticos de governança de IA para assegurar que sistemas de inteligência artificial usados em órgãos do Poder Judiciário brasileiro respeitem direitos fundamentais, transparência e imparcialidade. O Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ) é a entidade federal responsável por estabelecer diretrizes, monitorar implementações e fiscalizar conformidade com os princípios constitucionais. TL;DR O CNJ publicou a Resolução CNJ n. 483/2023 , que instituiu a Política Nacional de Inteligência Artificial no Poder Judiciário. A resolução exige avaliação de impacto ético e de viés antes da adoção de qualquer sistema de IA em processos judiciais.
articles.author: Matheus Feijão

articles.title: I put a real LLM in my portfolio. It runs on your GPU, not my server.
articles.excerpt: Every AI-engineer portfolio says "I build with LLMs." I wanted mine to prove it in the first ten seconds. So the chat box on my homepage has a button: Run a real LLM on your GPU. Click it and a 0.5B-p…
articles.body: Every AI-engineer portfolio says "I build with LLMs." I wanted mine to prove it in the first ten seconds. So the chat box on my homepage has a button: Run a real LLM on your GPU . Click it and a 0.5B-parameter model downloads into your browser, boots on your graphics card through WebGPU, and answers questions about my work. No server. No API key. Nothing you type leaves your machine. 👉 Try it: rahul-agarwal.in (desktop Chrome or Edge works best) Here's how it works, and the four things I got wrong before it worked well. What happens when you click the button The page checks for WebGPU and whether your GPU supports 16-bit floats. It lazy-loads WebLLM from a CDN (none of this code ships until you ask for it). It downloads Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (about 270 MB, 4-bit quantised).

articles.title: Tech debt is not dead. It chose the format of our referral codes.
articles.excerpt: "What happens if I create a voucher called P66666666 by hand?" I asked that on October 23, the morning of the day our referral program went to production. The answer started with: it can't exist. The…
articles.body: "What happens if I create a voucher called P66666666 by hand?" I asked that on October 23, the morning of the day our referral program went to production. The answer started with: it can't exist. The voucher code is a char(8) . PostgreSQL refuses a ninth character, and our admin form stops typing at eight. Some context. I run backend engineering at GoodBarber , an app platform. Our referral codes are rows in the voucher table that our back office has used for years, a choice explained in a separate post. No migration was allowed for this feature. Every constraint of that table, deliberate or accidental, became a constraint of the referral program.
articles.author: Pierre-Laurent Medori

articles.title: Why Git Shows Old Commit URLs After Squashing History
articles.excerpt: 📝 Originally published (in Japanese) at forge.workstyle.tech. TL;DR I was preparing to release Voice Canvas as OSS and found that an old commit URL still opened in my account after I squashed the Git…
articles.body: 📝 Originally published (in Japanese) at forge.workstyle.tech . TL;DR I was preparing to release Voice Canvas as OSS and found that an old commit URL still opened in my account after I squashed the Git history into 1 commit. The repository was private, and the same URL returned 404 when I was logged out. Since that did not confirm what would happen after publication, I recreated the repository before making it public. Conclusion First Even after squashing a Git history into a single commit, I could open an old commit URL while logged in to my account on a private repository. I recreated the repository with the same name and made it public, then confirmed that the old URL could not be opened while logged out.

articles.title: Peanuts Native brings 12 Switch games to Android without an emulator layer
articles.excerpt: The open-source translation layer builds on BananaNative, and supports dual-screen Android handhelds.
articles.body: Credit: AYN TL;DR Peanuts Native is a new open-source fork of BananaNative that converts 12 Nintendo Switch games into standalone Android apps without a traditional emulator layer. Created by the developer behind Eden Duo, it supports dual-screen Android handhelds like the AYN Thor by rendering interactive companion overlays with haptic feedback on the bottom display. Converting legally dumped game files takes five to 40 minutes on-device and requires Android 13 or later, at least 12GB of RAM, and a Snapdragon GPU with Vulkan 1.3 support. It’s an exciting time to be an Android emulation fan. Not only is the emulation scene moving quickly lately, but native recompilation projects are also speeding up, letting you bypass the emulator layer to run console titles “natively” on Android.

articles.body: SpaceX plans to launch its Starship megarocket on an unprecedented mission today (Nov. 13), and you can watch the action live. Starship is scheduled to launch on its 15th test flight today from SpaceX's Starbase site in South Texas, during a 75-minute window that opens at 5:45 p.m. EST (2245 GMT; 4:45 p.m. local Texas time). SpaceX plans to bring both of Starship's stages back to Starbase for a catch by the launch tower's "chopstick" arms — something it has never done before. You can watch it all live here at Space.com. And there should be a lot to see: Starship Flight 15 will last more than 22 hours, if all goes according to plan. Composite photo showing the Super Heavy booster of SpaceX's Starship megarocket coming in for a landing on the launch mount on Oct. 13, 2024.

NGC 206 and the Star Clouds of Andromeda Explanation: The large stellar association cataloged as NGC 206 is nestled within the dusty arms of the neighboring Andromeda galaxy along with the galaxy’s pinkish star-forming regions. Also known as M31, the spiral galaxy is a mere 2.5 million light-years away. NGC 206 is found at the center of this sharp and detailed close-up of the southwestern extent of Andromeda’s disk.
